text:
Gabe: Quick thread to capture remaining Qs from today's all-hands on GTM priorities, pipeline health, and partnership rollouts. Drop short Qs here and we'll answer in-thread so folks can reference later.

Tom: First one 97 is Q2 net-new ARR still $2.2M? Numbers in the deck and my notes differ.

Anika (CRO): Updated target is $2.5M net-new ARR for Q2. We tightened conversion assumptions and pushed some larger deals into the quarter to increase upside. Expect ~1.1M to be partner-influenced (referral or co-sell).

Tom: Good to know. Any change in ramp or comp for new reps joining this quarter?

Anika (CRO): Ramp remains 90 days with pro-rated quota. We added a short-term uplift for new hires: 10% quota relief month 1, 5% month 2. Comp plan docs updated in the sales handbook.

Maya (Head Customer Success): For partner-influenced enterprise deals, what does CS handoff look like? Will partners remain in the loop post-close?

Priya (Head of Partnerships): Yes, partners flagged as "engaged" will be included on the onboarding plan and optional touchpoints for first 90 days. We track partner NPS separately for co-sell accounts. Diego is running enablement for the pilot partners next Tue.

Diego (Partner PM): Pilot partners: SentrySys and BlueArc. Co-sell script and joint deck posted in #partners. Asking partners to attend intro calls for deals >100k ACV.

Ben (RevOps): Funnel topline: SQL volume +7% MoM, win rate on enterprise opps steady at 19%. Main risk is marketing-sourced lead velocity lagging. We're moving attribution windows to 90 days to better capture partner influence.

Tom: Attribution windows move makes sense. How are we crediting AEs vs partners? We've had confusion on renewals and expansion credit.

Priya (Head of Partnerships): New rule: partner gets referral credit on net-new if they introduced the account and are active in the 1st meeting. AE retains primary ACV and future expansions by default unless partner brings the expansion opportunity on signal. Renewals default to AE unless partner holds a reseller contract. Full matrix in the partner-credit doc.

Anika (CRO): To reduce ambiguity: any deal >200k needs a documented credit decision in SFDC before close (use the "partner-credit" checkbox). Deals stuck in dispute  DM me and Priya.

Tom: Pricing question: customers asking about Dedicated vs Private list pricing and security add-ons. Any new guidance?

Anika (CRO): No list price changes this quarter. We introduced a security add-on SKU for Private deployments (SOC2+HSM) that is a % uplift + minimum monthly commit. The enterprise terms playbook has examples: commit tiers, uplift %, and sample contract language. I'll post the TL;DR here.

Gabe: On GTM motions for the quarter: 1) PLG driving trials and convert to starter, 2) Targeted partner co-sell for regulated verticals, 3) Strategic accounts via dedicated AE squads. Prioritize regulated verticals for partner motion.

Maya (Head Customer Success): Any SLA changes for Dedicated/Private customer support? Ops asked about 24/7 support requirements tied to SLAs.

Anika (CRO): For Dedicated/Private, 24x7 support is available as an add-on. Base SLA remains 99.9% with business-hours support. Support add-on pricing and response times are in the SOW templates.

Ben (RevOps): Action items: 1) publish partner-credit matrix (Priya) by EOD Thu, 2) RevOps to update attribution window in SFDC by Fri (Ben), 3) Sales to get one-pager playbooks per GTM motion (Ben + PD) by next Wed.

Diego (Partner PM): Partner checklist update: adding required legal template and contact points for co-sell with SI partners. Will drop in #partners today.

Priya (Head of Partnerships): Marketplace update: AWS Marketplace live next week in controlled roll-out. Azure marketplace on track for mid-Q3. Working through procurement requirements for some EMEA customers.

Tom: Any recommended play for SDRs on partner-influenced inbound? Quick lines they can use in cadence?

Anika (CRO): Short play: 1) acknowledge partner intro in first touch, 2) mention co-sell capability + security add-on if enterprise, 3) request intro meeting with AE + partner rep on follow-up. PD will ship canned email snippets.

allhands-bot: All-hands follow-up deck and notes uploaded 10 https://drive.redwood.company/allhands/1770012345-gtm-pipeline-followup.pdf :page_facing_up:

Maya (Head Customer Success): I'll coordinate a quick cross-functional checklist for handoffs and share in #cs.

Gabe: Nice thread 97 thanks everyone. If you see any blockers on deals >250k please escalate to me directly. We'll review partner-influenced pipeline in the weekly GTM sync. :thumbsup:
